description: Belgian real estate from Zimmo with exact addresses, sold comps, commune prices per m² and a local store for deal sourcing.

novel_features.name: Bulk detail enrichment
novel_features.description: Refresh stored listings from Zimmo, resumably: status changes, price history, EPC, flood and planning flags, GPS.

novel_features.name: Cross-portal match
novel_features.description: Find the Immoweb or Immovlan twin of a Zimmo listing and the price gap between portals.

novel_features.name: Sold comps
novel_features.description: Sold or rented listings around one property with median €/m² and the subject's gap to it.

novel_features.name: PEB trap
novel_features.description: Energy-poor stored listings (EPC F/G or high kWh/m²), rented ones first with their rent, showing Zimmo's renovation-obligation flag.

novel_features.name: Underpriced vs commune
novel_features.description: Rank stored for-sale houses and apartments by discount to their commune's €/m² (viager, whole buildings and service flats skipped).

novel_features.name: Gross rental yield
novel_features.description: Gross rental yield of sale listings: the published rent when let, otherwise rentals of similar surface in the same postcode and type.

novel_features.name: Motivated seller score
novel_features.description: Rank listings by seller pressure: days on market, total price cut, re-listing, EPC.
